features: Browse local and remote branches in project history with a searchable, keyboard-accessible branch tree.
Keep multiple file comparisons open alongside regular file tabs, reuse existing comparisons, and restore comparison tabs when reopening project preview.
Load more project history automatically as you scroll, with retry support for failed loads.
changed: Streamlined project preview headers, file tabs, and document controls, with denser file trees and improved narrow-screen history layouts.
Plugin maintenance now waits up to 15 seconds for active calls to finish; a timeout fails only that maintenance operation.
fixed: Plugin maintenance no longer blocks chat subscriptions, refreshes, skill discovery, or maintenance of unrelated plugins.
Chat subscriptions and reconnects now receive the current state without waiting for plugin initialization or queued commands.
Missing or mismatched plugin packages, failed extension entries, and provider registration errors no longer disable other working plugins.
Stalled plugin initialization or cleanup in one work session no longer prevents other sessions from loading.
Project preview titles now follow project switches and browser navigation, including native desktop preview window titles.
Chat stays anchored to the bottom when width changes reflow messages.
Older sessions without Todo query support now hide the progress widget silently instead of showing a synchronization error.
Improved keyboard navigation between virtualized rows in the project history change tree.
removed: Removed the interaction hint footer from Todo details.
